subtitle: Who We Are
title: About Tarang
heading: The Cultural Heartbeat of the AIDS Department
paragraphs: Tarang (तरंग) — meaning "wave" in Hindi — is the official cultural club of the Artificial Intelligence & Data Science department at DIT Pimpri. We celebrate every festival, every occasion, and every tradition with full heart.

From Teachers Day to Dussehra, from Children's Day to Engineers Day and Science Day — Tarang brings colour, creativity, and community to every celebration. We believe that art and culture are the soul of every institution.
quote: Where every celebration becomes a memory, and every performance tells a story — Tarang is where the AIDS department truly comes alive.

pillars.title: Drama & Theatre
pillars.desc: Street plays, one-acts, and grand theatrical productions that bring stories to life.

pillars.title: Dance & Movement
pillars.desc: Classical, folk, and contemporary dance forms celebrated across every cultural event.

pillars.title: Music & Singing
pillars.desc: Vocal and instrumental performances honoring festivals, traditions, and cultural moments.

pillars.title: Visual Arts
pillars.desc: Rangoli, posters, digital art, and creative installations for every occasion.
